[Positron](https://positron.posit.co) is a next-generation data science IDE from
[Posit](https://posit.co) that combines ideas from RStudio and Visual Studio
Code. [Posit Assistant](https://positron.posit.co/assistant.html) is the AI
assistant built into Positron.

## Getting set up

* Setup guide: <https://posit-dev.github.io/positron-workshop/setup.html>
* Latest release: <https://positron.posit.co/download.html>
* Pre-releases: <https://github.com/posit-dev/positron/releases>

## Posit Assistant

[Posit Assistant](https://positron.posit.co/assistant.html) is the AI coding
experience in Positron:

* Overview and feature summary: <https://positron.posit.co/assistant.html>
* Setup and everything else: <https://pos.it/assistant-docs>

Note that Posit Assistant supersedes the older Positron Assistant and Databot.

## Going further

[Introduction to Positron](https://academy.posit.co/path/introduction-to-positron),
three self-paced courses on Posit Academy.

[Applied statistics with R](https://juliasilge.github.io/applied-stats-byu-2026/)
by [Julia Silge](https://juliasilge.com), a two-day workshop that goes deeper on
Positron and AI-assisted work inside a full modern R workflow
([source](https://github.com/juliasilge/applied-stats-byu-2026)).

The [Positron documentation](https://positron.posit.co).
